target: must_not_find is the primitive whose absence caused the traps: asserting a failure marker is ABSENT is what these cases actually needed
cmd:
mkdir -p c/syn
cat > c/syn/s.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "syn-3", "kind": "bash-unit", "target": "synthetic", "checks": [{"type": "must_not_find", "strings": ["FORBIDDEN"]}], "cmd": "echo hello FORBIDDEN world"}
CASEEOF
EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --suite syn >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{"code":%s}' $?
